column3: splitQuery keeps only the safe keys, in their original order
splitQuery names each withheld key once, and withholds keys it does not know
splitQuery handles an empty or missing query, with or without "?"
keys named after object properties are neither safe nor renamed
buildPayload leaves the plan link out unless it is ticked
buildPayload sends settings, withheld names and page errors only when settings is ticked
buildPayload names withheld fields readably and never carries their values
the state always goes with the settings, even at its default, and only a safe key can be pinned
the GitHub link fills the message, version and browser, and nothing about the plan
buildPayload sends the page address without its query or fragment
the message is trimmed, uses plain line breaks, and must be 1 to 5000 characters
validReplyTo accepts ordinary addresses and an empty box
validReplyTo refuses anything that could add a header or a second recipient
maskDigits hides every run of three or more digits
errorLine keeps the script file name and never the page query
resolveEndpoint honors ?fbdev only on a page served from localhost
resolveEndpoint refuses a page opened from disk, and a copy with no site key
dataUrlBytes measures the decoded image, padding included
the preview marks every unticked part and shows a screenshot only by its size
a refusal from the service is shown in plain words, never as raw server text
every share-link key is classified as safe or personal, exactly once
balances, income, spending, ages, dates and health coverage are all withheld
retirement_optimizer.html loads feedback.js early and wires the Feedback button
the GitHub issue form has the fields the link fills, and a required privacy check
the live page hands feedback.js its safe-key list and share-link builder
the dialog and the Worker agree on addresses and limits
Worker: only our own page origin is accepted, by exact match
Worker: CORS headers name the caller only when it is allowed
Worker: a screenshot must be a real JPEG of at most a megabyte
Worker: links must lead back to our own pages, and settings must be a plain query
Worker: messages are required, errors are capped, and unknown fields are dropped
Worker: the email uses CRLF only, and message text cannot start a header
Worker: a subject is folded or encoded so that no line is too long
Worker: the screenshot is attached only when there is one
Worker: the email body lists withheld names and marks what was left out
Worker: the bot check needs success, our hostname and the feedback action
Worker: a Turnstile test secret passes a local page and never the live site
Worker: the browser preflight is answered for our page and refused for others
Worker: a wrong method, origin, type or size is refused before anything is checked or sent
Worker: a missing address, secret or binding fails closed
Worker: the rate limit counts per sender address and stops the send
Worker: an invalid report or a failed bot check sends nothing
Worker: the daily limit is exact and starts again the next day
Worker: a full day refuses every report and sends nothing, and only a passed bot check counts
Worker: a good report sends one email to the configured inbox, with Reply-To and the screenshot
Worker: a failed send is reported, and every reply is readable by the page and echoes nothing
